# Angular Developer

Curated by Skill Harbor: a working skill for Angular development, from scaffolding to production. It generates components, services, directives, pipes, guards, and resolvers following Angular's style guide, with version-aware advice (it analyzes your project's Angular version first, since best practices shift between versions). Coverage includes modern reactivity with signals, linkedSignal, and resource; signal, reactive, and template-driven forms; dependency injection with hierarchical injectors; routing with lazy loading, guards, and resolvers; SSR and SSG rendering strategies; Angular Aria accessible components; Tailwind CSS integration; and testing from TestBed unit tests to Cypress and Playwright end-to-end. It even runs ng build after generating code and fixes errors before proceeding. By @affaan-m, listed here with credit to its creator. From the affaan-m/ECC repository (MIT). Honest caveats: pure guidance plus generated code, nothing to install as a package; you need the Angular CLI locally for scaffolding and builds, and the advice is version-sensitive, so confirm your Angular version first. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use.
